units.source_text: 一了解到这点，岛村感到仿佛有什么东西掠过自己的心头。

en.t: As soon as he understood this, Shimamura felt as though something had swept across his heart.

units.source_text: 但他对这种奇妙的因缘，并不觉得怎么奇怪，倒是对自己不觉得奇怪而感到奇怪。

en.t: Yet he did not find this strange twist of fate especially strange; rather, he found it strange that he did not find it strange.
